sloka: न च ते मर्षये पापम् क्ष्त्रियो अहम् कुलोद्गतः ।औरसीम् भगिनीम् वा अपि भार्याम् वा अपि अनुजस्य यः ॥४-१८-२२॥
transliteration: na ca te marṣaye pāpam kṣtriyo aham kulodgataḥ ।aurasīm bhaginīm vā api bhāryām vā api anujasya yaḥ ॥4-18-22॥

translations.english: 'I am a kshatriya born of a good family. I will not pardon you for your sin. Whosoever transgresses dharma against his own daughter, sister or brother's wife out of lust should be killed according to smriti.
